mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_token_usage_day ( stat_date, tenant_id, user_id, user_nick_name, agent_id, agent_name, model_config_id, provider, model_name, usage_source, request_count, success_count, failed_count, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, actual_tokens, estimated_tokens, unknown_count, create_time, last_modify_time, deleted ) VALUES ( #{statDate}, #{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{userNickName}, #{agentId}, #{agentName}, #{modelConfigId}, #{provider}, #{modelName}, #{usageSource}, #{requestCount}, #{successCount}, #{failedCount}, #{promptTokens}, #{completionTokens}, #{totalTokens}, #{actualTokens}, #{estimatedTokens}, #{unknownCount}, #{createTime}, #{lastModifyTime}, false ) ON CONFLICT (stat_date, tenant_id, user_id, agent_id, model_config_id, provider, model_name, usage_source) DO UPDATE SET request_count = agent_token_usage_day.request_count + EXCLUDED.request_count, success_count = agent_token_usage_day.success_count + EXCLUDED.success_count, failed_count = agent_token_usage_day.failed_count + EXCLUDED.failed_count, prompt_tokens = agent_token_usage_day.prompt_tokens + EXCLUDED.prompt_tokens, completion_tokens = agent_token_usage_day.completion_tokens + EXCLUDED.completion_tokens, total_tokens = agent_token_usage_day.total_tokens + EXCLUDED.total_tokens, actual_tokens = agent_token_usage_day.actual_tokens + EXCLUDED.actual_tokens, estimated_tokens = agent_token_usage_day.estimated_tokens + EXCLUDED.estimated_tokens, unknown_count = agent_token_usage_day.unknown_count + EXCLUDED.unknown_count, user_nick_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.user_nick_name, ''), agent_token_usage_day.user_nick_name), agent_name = COALESCE(NULLIF(EXCLUDED.agent_name, ''), agent_token_usage_day.agent_name), last_modify_time = EXCLUDED.last_modify_time, deleted = false
